controls.source: GOB 107 authors a 5 m ground area and Blind with separate 15% Daze, Off-Balance and Staggered with a 12 s base. The four state records are timed without a separate Stun/Pacify immunity marker.
controls.runtime: The ground request supplies the centre. The area predicate uses live visible hostile recipients, sight and the current floor/radius policy. Stock center Y=400 and actor Y=495 retained the 95-unit vertical difference. Target source 151 contributed +5 Determination Bonus in the same fixture; the current control-duration calculation matches 12 to 11.4 s. This validates the observed recipients and duration in the current model. Original horizontal versus 3D ground-radius edge behavior remains unobserved.
controls.test: Final cast hit QAEnemy and QAOther only; the scoped QA aid landed all four listed states on QAEnemy, while QAOther landed Blind alone. All five records removed. PR1027 stock confirms the player recipient additions and removals, the measured centre, correct exclusions and no damage or interlock. SpyBombsAndParalyzingThrowTests verifies the exact equal-height radius edges, floor exclusion, base durations, independent chance thresholds and callback. PR546 supplies caster Blind chat and the NPC landing. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/1027#issuecomment-7114864744 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/546#issuecomment-7082231278
